tasks.label: tachyon: build-dev-host
tasks.command: set -euo pipefail; WF="${workspaceFolder}"; if [ -e "$WF/.tachyon/dev-host/extension" ]; then PTR="$WF/.tachyon/dev-host"; HOST="$WF"; else HOST="$WF"; if [ -f "$WF/.git" ]; then COMMON="$(git -C "$WF" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [ -n "${COMMON:-}" ] && [ -f "$(dirname "$COMMON")/package.json" ]; then HOST="$(dirname "$COMMON")"; fi; fi; BASE="$HOST/.tachyon/dev-host"; if [ -e "$BASE/extension" ]; then PTR="$BASE"; else echo "Tachyon Dev Host is not armed under this checkout:" >&2; echo "  workspaceFolder: $WF" >&2; echo "  looked at: $WF/.tachyon/dev-host/extension" >&2; echo "  and: $BASE/extension" >&2; echo "Arm from the same checkout you F5 from:" >&2; echo "  cd $WF && npm run dogfood -- dev-host point --worktree $WF --fixture <slug> --spec <n> --slug <s>" >&2; echo "  npm run dogfood -- dev-host point-status" >&2; exit 1; fi; fi; if [ ! -e "$PTR/extension" ]; then echo "Tachyon Dev Host missing extension at $PTR/extension" >&2; exit 1; fi; EXT="$(cd "$PTR/extension" && pwd -P)"; NM_SRC="$HOST/node_modules"; if [ ! -d "$NM_SRC" ]; then if [ -f "$WF/.git" ]; then COMMON="$(git -C "$WF" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [ -n "${COMMON:-}" ] && [ -d "$(dirname "$COMMON")/node_modules" ]; then NM_SRC="$(dirname "$COMMON")/node_modules"; fi; fi; fi; if [ ! -d "$NM_SRC" ] && [ -d "$WF/node_modules" ]; then NM_SRC="$WF/node_modules"; fi; test -d "$EXT/node_modules" || ln -sfn "$NM_SRC" "$EXT/node_modules"; node --input-type=module -e "import { ensureDevHostTmuxLaunchEnv } from './scripts/dev-host/pointer.mjs'; const r=ensureDevHostTmuxLaunchEnv(process.argv[1]); console.log('build-dev-host: tmux='+r.tmuxTmpDir);" "$HOST"; echo "build-dev-host: WF=$WF PTR=$PTR EXT=$EXT"; TACHYON_ENGINE_CHANNEL=dev npm run build --prefix "$EXT"
